============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1186 ns | 843,185 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1722 ns | 580,603 | 350 | 1.45x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2771 ns | 360,850 | 350 | 2.34x slower |
| google-protobuf |   6014 ns | 166,268 | 350 | 5.07x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4106 ns | 243,523 | 622 | 3.46x slower |
| JSON |   2338 ns | 427,662 | 791 | 1.97x slower |
